addr: 4th Main Rd, Sector 3, HSR Layout, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560102, India

rev.t: Max is a great place for budget-friendly shopping with good-quality fabrics. They have a nice variety of clothes for everyday wear, and the prices are quite reasonable. A good option for affordable and quality shopping.

Changing my review to 5 star after recent visit. They have excellent and unique collection at reasonable pricing. Very well.organized shop and helpful staff. Quality of cloths are good. However they need to.add more changing rooms and provide better shopping schemes for bulk purchase.

It's a four-storey store with an amazing variety of collections for men, women, and children. You can find everything from trendy western wear to elegant ethnic outfits. The toy, accessories, and bag sections also have a wide range of options to explore. A great place for one-stop shopping!
